title: Negation followed by its positive replacement becomes a formula

provenance.note: The two sentence forms are the examples preserved in the prose-craft and prosody source comments after a finished-book reading.

manuscript.quote: It was not a handshake. It was a grip. He did not shift his weight. He did not check his watch.

diagnosis: Repeated denial-and-replacement makes the next sentence predictable and spends two sentences stating one fact.

test.text: It was not a handshake. It was a grip. He did not shift his weight. He did not check his watch. It was not a greeting. It was a warning. The room held its breath while the clock continued above the door.
